About the Role:

At TELUS Digital, we are bridging the gap between how a human thinks and how a machine writes code. As a Full-Stack AI Logic Specialist, you will join an elite squad of developers tasked with training AI to master the entire development lifecycle—from front-end interfaces to back-end logic. You aren't just writing code; you are teaching AI how to think like a Senior Engineer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Logic & Syntax Validation: Audit AI-generated code in Python and JavaScript to ensure it is functional and follows clean-code principles.

  • Security Auditing: Evaluate code for common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection or buffer overflows, to ensure the AI creates secure software.

  • Multi-Turn Debugging: Design scenarios where the AI must identify, explain, and fix bugs within an existing codebase.

  • Prompt Optimization: Improve the relationship between natural language instructions and functional code outputs.

  • Library Testing: Check how the AI uses popular frameworks and libraries (like React or Django) to ensure high-quality results.

Qualification path

Mandatory Qualifications:

  • Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Technical Expertise: Proficiency in Python and JavaScript is essential. Knowledge of Java, C++, or Go is a plus.

  • Native Language:Native-level proficiency in your primary language to assist with localized technical comments and documentation.

  • English Proficiency:Basic (B1) English to follow project guidelines and collaborate with our global team.

  • Problem-Solving: A "Senior Reviewer" mindset with a passion for clean, efficient code.

Assessment:

In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.

Payment:

Currently, pay rates for experts range from $25 - $50 USD per hour

Our Payment terms are defined for each project.

Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community:

  • Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts.

  • Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.

  • Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.

  • Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects.

  • Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.
